## Changed Pharmacy opening policy
src/App.tsx passes the active workspace to CashShift. src/screens/CashShift.tsx disables new Pharmacy shift opening unless GET terminals/whoami cash_node is PharmacyCounter, displays bilingual IT mapping explanation, and rechecks the fresh terminal mapping before a new POST. No node picker, client mapping change or permission bypass. Existing own-drawer close/reconciliation remains available to safely finish prior work. Updated bilingual help; server-scoped navigation already consumes the newly linked page.

## Direct policy test
cashOpeningAllowed unit checks permit PharmacyCounter in Pharmacy, refuse MainReception/null there and preserve actual MainReception/PharmacyCounter mapping in Reception. UI compiles with that same policy in button, submit and fresh preflight. This is partial unit evidence; runtime scoped route/open-close/help and positive Cash need DEV after maintenance.

## Changed OTC cash policy
src/screens/OTCMode.tsx now reads mine?node=PharmacyCounter before Cash is available and in fresh submission preflight, rather than accepting any mapped counter. Cash option/review/confirmation require a verified own Open PharmacyCounter shift; Card remains available. Shows IT mapping guidance and the server own other-counter drawer from SHIFT_NOT_OPEN.details.open_shift.node without borrowing/changing it. Updated bilingual controls/task inventory.

Only this locally tested policy rule is proposed; real Cash collection/reply/UI verification is pending.

## Changed Dispense policy
src/screens/Dispense.tsx uses current generated discharge-status identity and stage fields instead of forbidden full-admission reads. Shows patient/MRN/admission number and cleared-by/time, requires exact admission/patient plus next Pending Pharmacy stage, reads status for unknown-result reconciliation, never automatically retries. Cash reads mine?node=PharmacyCounter before offering it and again before POST; own-user/Open/node policy is shared, Card stays available, scoped My cash shift link added, actual details.open_shift.node explains another counter.
